title: Transport of rational scalar path squares to coefficient categories
statement: For two families of rational model fibre functors and natural isomorphisms between them, a compatible scalar comparison square remains compatible after the recorded coefficient category-value transports, giving the square for lisseCoefficientFiberRawComparison. Definitions and hypotheses are those of [lem-pod-lisse-coefficient-fiber-comparisons], [new-e5-normalized-fibre-comparisons].

source.place: Weil II (1.1.1) b)-d), pp.146-147; explicit part of the fibre transport argument

proof.text: The raw comparison is the rational comparison whiskered by the category-value transport, followed by cancellation of the target transport. The cancellation comparison is independent of the point. Apply the generic transportCoefficientComparison_path theorem, whose proof uses naturality of the target path with this fixed cancellation.

proof_origin.place: Weil II (1.1.1) b)-d); complete Lean construction for lem-wf-fibre-functor-basepoint-transport

lean.statement:
theorem coefficientFiberRawComparison_path
    (S S' : ∀ E : Padic.FiniteCoefficientFields l K,
      LisseRationalSheaf l E.val Y ⥤ ModuleCat.{u + 1} E.val)
    (δ : ∀ E : Padic.FiniteCoefficientFields l K, S E ≅ S' E)
    (E L : Padic.FiniteCoefficientFields l K) (f : E ⟶ L)
    (e : S E ⋙ ModuleCat.extendScalars (algebraMap E.val K) ≅
      lisseRationalScalarExtension l E.val Y L.val
        (IntermediateField.inclusion (leOfHom f)) ⋙ S L ⋙
          ModuleCat.extendScalars (algebraMap L.val K))
    (e' : S' E ⋙ ModuleCat.extendScalars (algebraMap E.val K) ≅
      lisseRationalScalarExtension l E.val Y L.val
        (IntermediateField.inclusion (leOfHom f)) ⋙ S' L ⋙
          ModuleCat.extendScalars (algebraMap L.val K))
    (h : e ≪≫ Functor.isoWhiskerLeft
        (lisseRationalScalarExtension l E.val Y L.val
          (IntermediateField.inclusion (leOfHom f)))
        (Functor.isoWhiskerRight (δ L) (ModuleCat.extendScalars (algebraMap L.val K))) =
      Functor.isoWhiskerRight (δ E) (ModuleCat.extendScalars (algebraMap E.val K)) ≪≫ e') :
    lisseCoefficientFiberRawComparison l Y K S E L f e ≪≫
        Functor.isoWhiskerLeft
          ((lisseCoefficientDiagramData l Y K).diagram.map f.toLoc).toFunctor
          (Functor.isoWhiskerLeft
            (eqToHom ((lisseCoefficientDiagramData l Y K).obj_eq L)).toFunctor
            (Functor.isoWhiskerRight (δ L)
              (ModuleCat.extendScalars (algebraMap L.val K)))) =
      Functor.isoWhiskerLeft
        (eqToHom ((lisseCoefficientDiagramData l Y K).obj_eq E)).toFunctor
        (Functor.isoWhiskerRight (δ E) (ModuleCat.extendScalars (algebraMap E.val K))) ≪≫
          lisseCoefficientFiberRawComparison l Y K S' E L f e'
